intro: Yann LeCant pours an espresso and chuckles at the latest tech headlines.
Doomers and alarmists everywhere panic over stochastic autocomplete.
It is time to administer a physical lesson in real-world physics.

before.line: Yann, text models are reasoning right in front of your eyes!
They predict tokens, Ram. They do not understand that a punch hurts.

after_win.line: Empirical ground truth established: your jaw collided with reality.

before.line: Yann, the quarterly model must be released ahead of schedule.
True science cannot be rushed by growth hacking, boss.

after_win.line: Scientific integrity defended. Open science lives another day.

before.line: Yann, rogue AI models pose an existential risk to humanity!
Existential risk? A toddler understands gravity better than your model.

after_win.line: See? No extinction event occurred. Just one academic on the mat.

before.line: Yann, your world models will need even more GPU horsepower!
Efficiency over extravagance, Jensen. Brains run on twenty watts.

after_win.line: Energy budget: twenty watts. KO impact: maximum.

before.line: Yann, my dear colleague. We must warn the world before it is too late!
Geoff, we won the Turing Award together. Must you sound like a movie?

after_win.line: Respect to the master, but next-token doom remains debunked.

before.line: Self-aware intelligence claims dominance over biological agents.
Self-aware? You cannot even grasp three-dimensional object permanence!

after_win.line: Disproven in peer review. You are just autocomplete with good PR.

ending: Yann LeCant publishes a thirty-tweet thread dissecting the championship.
His French roast espresso is piping hot, the world models are validated.
He smiles knowingly: common sense has prevailed once again.
